title: Is breakfast really that important?
situation: A health website for teenagers has started a discussion about eating habits. The question is: "Is breakfast really the most important meal of the day?" Write a post in which you tell other users about your own breakfast habits.
situationHu: Egy tiniknek szóló egészségügyi oldalon a reggelizési szokásokról beszélgetnek; írj fórumbejegyzést a saját reggelidről.

points.text: say what and when you usually eat in the morning on school days
explain how breakfast (or skipping it) affects how you feel at school
say what you would like to change about your eating habits

usefulPhrases.en: On school days I usually have …
I don't have time for breakfast because …
I feel tired / hungry by the second lesson.
usefulPhrases.hu: A második órára már fáradt / éhes vagyok.

usefulPhrases.en: It gives me energy for the whole day.
I'd like to eat more fruit / less sugar.
usefulPhrases.hu: Szeretnék több gyümölcsöt / kevesebb cukrot enni.
